text:
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window starting 2025-07-15 04:00 UTC across api, runtime, console, router. Planned versions: api v2.4.1, runtime rev-3b2, console v1.9.0, router fastpath-17. Pinning plan: API pinned to v2.4.1 for 24h after promotion. Please call out any blockers now. Release notes draft: https://redwood.internal/releases/2025-07-15 :calendar:

kaitlyn: ack. final release notes pushed to the release page. Console migration is a tiny one-line DB change (add nullable col). @mike can you sanity-check the console feature flag defaults? :mag:

mike: I ran api v2.4.1 + runtime rev-3b2 integration tests locally, sessions and auth headers look fine. Note: added/changed header x-rw-trace — runtime should tolerate absence. I'll add a compatibility shim in runtime if needed.

runtime-oncall: heads up — rev-3b2 has a KV cache layout tweak. Canary will start 10% on dedicated pool. We'll emit metric kv-miss-rate.kv_cache and alert if >5% sustained over 3m. Prewarm recommended.

router-lead: routing update required to forward x-rw-trace. I'll stage a router config change and ramp weights slowly. Example snippet to apply:
```
route: /v1/*
  -> pool: fastpath-17
  pass_headers: [x-rw-trace]
  canary_weight: 10
```
I'll apply the config after canary start.

deploy-bot: Canary started. Instances: api(3/3 up), runtime(2/2 up), console(1/1 up), router(2/2 up). Canary traffic: 10%.

samira: Observability check - current token-p95 latency +6ms vs baseline, error-rate steady. I'm watching logs for 5xx and auth failures. I'll escalate if 5xx > 0.5% over 5m. :eyes:

kaitlyn: Rollback plan reminder: if console migration fails, revert console to v1.8.9 and pin API back to v2.4.0. Console runbook updated in the notes with the rollback command and migration revert steps.

mike: Another note — runtime model cache warmup can cause initial latency. Suggest a prewarm job before ramping traffic: `infra/tools/prewarm --pool fastpath-17 --keys 100`.

runtime-oncall: kicking off prewarm now, progress ~40%.

deploy-bot: Canary at +30 minutes: traffic shifted to 30%. No increase in 5xx or errors reported. Rollback window open until 05:30 UTC. Monitoring hooks active.

router-lead: :thumbsup: keeping ramp conservative. Added extra logging to detect header mismatch early.

sophia: quick check — console feature flag beta is ON for canary only (console-toggle:bff). I'll flip it off if we see any mismatch with production behaviors.

deploy-bot: Final plan: promote to 100% at 05:40 UTC unless any blocker surfaces. Final release notes link + PR: https://redwood.internal/releases/2025-07-15/notes (PR #5123). Post-promotion monitor window 60m. Notify in #incidents if you hit anything severe. :rocket:
